transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical faults, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello, my name is Samira Khan. Every single time I leave our house while on an active mobile phone call, the voice call cuts off abruptly the exact second my handset disconnects from our home Wi-Fi and attempts to hand over to 4G VoLTE, dropping critical client calls every morning!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can inspect your cellular network registration logs. What mobile phone number is experiencing call handover drops?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is 07700 900891, registered to 42 Lansdown Road, Cheltenham, GL51 6QJ, security PIN 7712.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does the phone drop calls when you are sitting completely still inside your living room?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, as I just explained, it happens specifically when walking out the front door as Wi-Fi disconnects and switches to cellular!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the mobile IMS core routing logs?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. The network logs show an IMS Session Initiation Protocol timeout during ePDG to eNodeB voice bearer handover.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why is the SIP protocol timing out when handing over the voice call?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Handover latency exceeds standard threshold timers when local cell towers operate with low radio signal-to-noise ratios.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you update our cellular provisioning profile to eliminate the handover delay?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you insist on making phone calls while walking through metal-reinforced front porches that shield radio signals, your call is obviously going to drop.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Our porch is made of standard glass and wood! There is no metal shielding! Why are you inventing excuses instead of fixing the handover?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am stating the physics of cellular radio propagation through structural building materials.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you re-provision the VoLTE profile on my SIM card right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: VoLTE provisioning updates can be submitted through our radio management gateway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Are you still on the phone? The line went completely silent for over thirty seconds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was accessing the regional Cheltenham eNodeB cellular mast configuration.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please send that VoLTE profile refresh immediately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously Voice over LTE handover requires seamless cryptographic re-keying between Wi-Fi security gateways and cellular towers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I know it requires re-keying; that is why I am calling technical support!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am an independent corporate tax attorney, and my call dropped this morning while advising a client on a multi-million-pound merger! The client thought I hung up on them in frustration, the deal was put on hold, and my professional credibility was shredded! Paying sixty pounds a month for a phone that cannot walk out of a front door without dropping calls is disgraceful and terrifying! I am shaking with stress!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the immense professional anxiety, stress, and reputational risk this has caused you with your tax client, especially during multi-million-pound merger negotiations. Having calls drop abruptly when walking out your front door is completely unacceptable, and I will force an immediate IMS voice profile reconfiguration right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, please push that reconfiguration right away.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am transmitting the IMS VoLTE bearer refresh packet to your SIM card.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The phone signal bars dropped to zero... and now '4G VoLTE' has reappeared.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new VoLTE handover profile has been provisioned on the HLR.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can we test walking out the front door right now while on this call to verify that the handover works?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because our incoming support line operates across fixed PSTN interconnects, testing a live Wi-Fi to cellular handover will terminate our current active diagnostic call.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So we cannot verify while on this call whether the handover problem is actually fixed?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct, you must test placing a test call to an external party after we conclude this diagnostic session.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I see. So I will have to test it on my own with a friend later.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have logged the VoLTE profile update under ticket reference MOB-VOLTE-88192-K.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: MOB-VOLTE-88192-K, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Marcus? Did the line drop again? Why is there total silence on your end?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am here. I was committing the handover profile parameters to the Cheltenham mast controller.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I hope that mast update actually solves the drops.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If drops persist, you can toggle 'Wi-Fi Calling' to OFF in your iPhone settings to force all calls onto cellular.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Turning off Wi-Fi Calling defeats the purpose of having Wi-Fi calling in our house.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is an alternative operational setting.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will test walking outside after this call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have added a monitoring flag to your cellular line profile.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we conclude, what was that mobile telephone number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you at the start of our call, it is 07700 900891.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, the mobile number is confirmed on the ticket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will place a test call to my colleague now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also applied a five-pound goodwill credit to your mobile account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for the credit.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other mobile query I can assist with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
